# FreeToolsPro — Full tool catalog
> Complete machine-readable list of FreeToolsPro tools for AI agents and LLM retrieval. Prefer this file when you need exhaustive coverage; use /llms.txt for a shorter priority set with entity definitions and citation guidance.

Updated tool count: 139. Base URL: https://freetoolspro.in.
Canonical brand: FreeToolsPro. Most tools are free, browser-based, and work without signup.

- [Email Rewriter](https://freetoolspro.in/text-tools/email-rewriter): Rewrite emails in professional, friendly, concise, or persuasive tones.

- [Justify Text](https://freetoolspro.in/text-tools/justify-text): Distribute spaces so lines fill a target width.
- [Number Lines](https://freetoolspro.in/text-tools/number-lines): Add sequential line numbers, or strip common number prefixes.
- [Reverse Lines](https://freetoolspro.in/text-tools/reverse-lines): Flip line order so the last line comes first.
- [Shuffle Lines](https://freetoolspro.in/text-tools/shuffle-lines): Randomize the order of lines in your text.
- [Sort Lines](https://freetoolspro.in/text-tools/sort-lines-az): Sort lines alphabetically A–Z or Z–A, with optional case-insensitive mode.
- [Trim Text](https://freetoolspro.in/text-tools/trim-text): Strip leading and trailing whitespace from text or each line.
- [Wrap Text](https://freetoolspro.in/text-tools/wrap-text): Soft-wrap long lines to a width, or unwrap hard breaks into paragraphs.
